completion:

4. If there is only one record in the Middle, try to eliminate it.

5. If there is more than one record in the Middle, try to eliminate the ones with less damage or injury as those can compound the other events.
6. If unable to eliminate any events, try to:
    - Falsify injuries to make them less serious.
    - Remove events that happened when no one was in the area or could be harmed.
